parts.zh: 上周末，一名男子的6岁儿子从多家餐厅订购了一顿“虚拟自助餐”
基思·斯通豪斯说，上周六晚上
大部分食物都放进了家里的冰箱
M: 是啊，你今天做了什么？
W: 我和凯西只是逛了逛老城区
W: 非常漂亮，不过游客太多了
M: 是啊，到处都很拥挤
W: 是啊，感觉全世界的人都来这里度假了
M: 我还没决定。我在考虑做你今天做的事
W: 那是什么地方？我没听说过

items.stem: Why was Keith Stonehouse left with a $1,000 bill?

choices.text: He had bought meals with his online food ordering account.
choices.zh: 他曾使用自己的网上点餐账户购买餐食。

choices.text: His son had used his cell phone to pay for playing a game.
choices.zh: 他的儿子曾用他的手机支付玩游戏的费用。

choices.text: His son had ordered food from several restaurants.
choices.zh: 他的儿子曾从几家餐馆订餐。

choices.text: He had dined out at a famous five-star restaurant.
choices.zh: 他曾在一家著名的五星级餐厅用餐。

items.stem: What does the news report say Keith Stonehouse is planning to do?

choices.text: Teach his son a lesson.
choices.zh: 给他的儿子一个教训。

choices.text: Change his password.
choices.zh: 更改他的密码。

choices.text: Ask his neighbors for help.
choices.zh: 向邻居求助。

choices.text: Buy a bigger refrigerator.
choices.zh: 买一台更大的冰箱。

items.stem: What did animal behaviour experts do according to the news report?

choices.text: They examined how visitors affected animal behaviour in zoos.
choices.zh: 他们研究了游客如何影响动物园中动物的行为。

choices.text: They studied when the best time to feed animals in public was.
choices.zh: 他们研究了在公众场合喂食动物的最佳时间。

choices.text: They studied how animals adapted themselves to life in zoos.
choices.zh: 他们研究了动物如何适应动物园生活。

choices.text: They examined what behaviours indicated animal boredom.
choices.zh: 他们研究了哪些行为表明动物感到无聊。

items.stem: Why have some animal species likely become used to the presence of humans?

choices.text: They socialise with zookeepers as well as with each other.
choices.zh: 它们既与动物园饲养员交往，也彼此交往。

choices.text: They show good adaptability to living with humans.
choices.zh: 它们表现出与人类共同生活的良好适应性。

choices.text: They have been kept as pets by humans.
choices.zh: 它们曾被人类当作宠物饲养。

choices.text: They have been born and raised in zoos.
choices.zh: 它们出生并成长于动物园。

items.stem: What is Denver doing with its popular electric bike incentive program?

choices.text: Adjusting it.
choices.zh: 调整该计划。

choices.text: Suspending it.
choices.zh: 暂停该计划。

choices.text: Reevaluating it.
choices.zh: 重新评估该计划。

choices.text: Expanding it.
choices.zh: 扩大该计划。

items.stem: How did the electric bike incentive program benefit residents?

choices.text: They could buy an electric bike for $400 in April.
choices.zh: 他们可以在四月份花400美元购买一辆电动自行车。

choices.text: They could buy their first electric bike at a discount.
choices.zh: 他们可以以折扣价购买自己的第一辆电动自行车。

choices.text: They could enjoy free after-sale service for their purchase.
choices.zh: 他们可以享受所购电动自行车的免费售后服务。

choices.text: They could get $1,200 from government funds if they qualified.
choices.zh: 如果符合条件，他们可以从政府资金中获得1200美元。

items.stem: What does the city of Denver expect to do early next year?

choices.text: Put 400 more electric bikes on its streets.
choices.zh: 在街头投放另外400辆电动自行车。

choices.text: Increase the program funding by 8 percent.
choices.zh: 将该计划的资金增加8%。

choices.text: Resume its electric bike incentive program.
choices.zh: 恢复其电动自行车激励计划。

choices.text: Invest millions of dollars into the local economy.
choices.zh: 向当地经济投入数百万美元。

items.stem: What exhibits does the man like best in the museum he visited?

choices.text: The coin collection.
choices.zh: 硬币收藏。

choices.text: The primitive tools.
choices.zh: 原始工具。

choices.text: The ancient ornaments.
choices.zh: 古代饰品。

choices.text: The 2,000-year-old clothes.
choices.zh: 有两千年历史的服装。

items.stem: What does the woman say about the old city centre?

choices.text: It is charming with narrow but beautiful streets.
choices.zh: 这里虽然街道狭窄，但很迷人美丽。

choices.text: It attracts visitors from every corner of the world.
choices.zh: 它吸引着来自世界各地的游客。

choices.text: It has flowers displayed around the Trevi Fountain.
choices.zh: 特莱维喷泉周围摆放着鲜花。

choices.text: It is more attractive than the pictures in guidebooks.
choices.zh: 它比旅游指南中的图片更有吸引力。

items.stem: What does the man say about the square with the Spanish steps?

choices.text: It is covered with wild grass.
choices.zh: 广场上长满了野草。

choices.text: It is very famous and pretty.
choices.zh: 它非常著名，也很漂亮。

choices.text: It is located away from an old church.
choices.zh: 它远离一座古老的教堂。

choices.text: It is surrounded by Spanish-style houses.
choices.zh: 它周围环绕着西班牙风格的房屋。

items.stem: What does the woman say she is going to do first?

choices.text: Ask Kathy what her plan is.
choices.zh: 问凯茜有什么计划。

choices.text: Tell Kathy Mike will join them.
choices.zh: 告诉凯茜迈克会加入他们。

choices.text: Ask Kathy if she'd like to see the square.
choices.zh: 问凯茜是否愿意去看看那个广场。

choices.text: Tell Kathy Mike would like to have a change.
choices.zh: 告诉凯茜迈克想换换环境。

items.stem: What advice does the man want to get from the woman?

choices.text: How to fit into the bigger picture.
choices.zh: 如何融入更大的整体。

choices.text: How to get on with colleagues.
choices.zh: 如何与同事相处。

choices.text: How to create a solid first impression.
choices.zh: 如何树立良好的第一印象。

choices.text: How to succeed in a new job.
choices.zh: 如何在新工作中取得成功。

items.stem: What does the woman say is the most important thing for the man to do at first?

choices.text: Get familiar with all the details of his job description.
choices.zh: 熟悉工作说明中的所有细节。

choices.text: Learn about the relations within the organization.
choices.zh: 了解组织内部的关系。

choices.text: Recognize his own limitations and weaknesses.
choices.zh: 认识到自己的局限和弱点。

choices.text: Understand his role from various perspectives.
choices.zh: 从不同角度理解自己的角色。

items.stem: What does the man say he is feeling a bit uneasy about?

choices.text: Learning history.
choices.zh: 学习历史。

choices.text: Meeting his boss.
choices.zh: 与老板见面。

choices.text: Creating reports for other departments to use.
choices.zh: 为其他部门使用而制作报告。

choices.text: Leaving his coworkers in the present company.
choices.zh: 离开现在公司的同事。

items.stem: What does the woman suggest the man do to gain insight about the running of the business?

choices.text: Get to know the decision-makers.
choices.zh: 了解决策者。

choices.text: Acquire decision-making authority.
choices.zh: 获得决策权。

choices.text: Promote its products and services.
choices.zh: 推广其产品和服务。

choices.text: Observe its overall management.
choices.zh: 观察其整体管理情况。

items.stem: What does research indicate about many consumers when they evaluate a purchase?

choices.text: They do not tell marketers their feeling about a product.
choices.zh: 他们不会告诉营销人员自己对某一产品的感受。

choices.text: They do not compare competing brands and prices.
choices.zh: 他们不会比较竞争品牌和价格。

choices.text: They are not hesitant to contradict themselves.
choices.zh: 他们毫不犹豫地自相矛盾。

choices.text: They are not sure what they really like to buy.
choices.zh: 他们不确定自己真正喜欢购买什么。

items.stem: What do good marketers keep in mind all the time?

choices.text: Consumers are often attracted by new products.
choices.zh: 消费者常常会被新产品吸引。

choices.text: Consumers tend to make decisions on the spot.
choices.zh: 消费者往往会当场作出决定。

choices.text: Consumers find it hard to resist temptation.
choices.zh: 消费者觉得很难抵制诱惑。

choices.text: Consumers are actually driven by emotion.
choices.zh: 消费者实际上是受情感驱动的。

items.stem: What should marketers do besides stressing the features of a product?

choices.text: Draw consumers' attention to the luxury goods symbolizing quality life.
choices.zh: 将消费者的注意力吸引到象征高品质生活的奢侈品上。

choices.text: Leave consumers the impression they are doing nothing manipulative.
choices.zh: 让消费者觉得他们没有在进行任何操纵。

choices.text: Highlight the emotional response it will trigger in the consumer.
choices.zh: 强调产品将引发消费者的情感反应。

choices.text: Remind consumers of the wide connections it can help to build.
choices.zh: 提醒消费者产品可以帮助建立广泛的人际联系。

items.stem: What does the passage say about Americans?

choices.text: They are taking in a lot of plastic.
choices.zh: 他们摄入了大量塑料。

choices.text: They are polluting the environment.
choices.zh: 他们正在污染环境。

choices.text: They consume much processed food.
choices.zh: 他们食用大量加工食品。

choices.text: They make everything with plastics.
choices.zh: 他们用塑料制造一切东西。

items.stem: What counted as the biggest sources for Americans breathing in or consuming microplastics?

choices.text: Beer, salts and added sugars.
choices.zh: 啤酒、盐和添加糖。

choices.text: Tap water and take-away food.
choices.zh: 自来水和外带食品。

choices.text: Food packages and plastic bags.
choices.zh: 食品包装和塑料袋。

choices.text: Air, bottled water and seafood.
choices.zh: 空气、瓶装水和海鲜。

items.stem: What does the passage say is still unknown?

choices.text: How much plastic there is in the remaining 85% of Americans' typical diet.
choices.zh: 美国人日常饮食中剩余的85%含有多少塑料。

choices.text: What measures can be taken to prevent plastic objects from fragmenting.
choices.zh: 可以采取哪些措施来防止塑料物品碎裂。

choices.text: What harm microplastics may actually do to the average Americans.
choices.zh: 微塑料实际上可能对普通美国人造成多大危害。

choices.text: How many ways there are for microplastics to get into food and air.
choices.zh: 微塑料进入食物和空气的方式有多少种。

items.stem: What did over half of the respondents say in the survey?

choices.text: They planned to adopt a pet animal.
choices.zh: 他们计划养一只宠物。

choices.text: They kept not only a dog but a cat.
choices.zh: 他们养的不仅有狗，还有猫。

choices.text: They had at least one pet.
choices.zh: 他们至少养有一只宠物。

choices.text: They liked cats more than dogs.
choices.zh: 他们比起狗更喜欢猫。

items.stem: What did most older pet owners in the survey say their pets provided?

choices.text: A sense of pride.
choices.zh: 自豪感。

choices.text: A sense of duty.
choices.zh: 责任感。

choices.text: A sense of purpose.
choices.zh: 目标感。

choices.text: A sense of security.
choices.zh: 安全感。

items.stem: What does the passage say people did report in the survey?

choices.text: A few problems with keeping big animals.
choices.zh: 饲养大型动物时遇到的一些问题。

choices.text: Some disadvantages related to pet ownership.
choices.zh: 与养宠物有关的一些不利之处。

choices.text: A few cases of getting attacked by pet animals.
choices.zh: 少数遭到宠物攻击的案例。

choices.text: Some conflicts with neighbors due to pet keeping.
choices.zh: 因养宠物而与邻居发生的一些冲突。

items.stem: What does research show interacting with pets can do?

choices.text: Reduce as many symptoms of depression as medical help.
choices.zh: 像医疗帮助一样减轻同样多的抑郁症状。

choices.text: Improve people's health as much as physical activities.
choices.zh: 像体育活动一样改善人们的健康。

choices.text: Lower older people's stress as effectively as exercising.
choices.zh: 像锻炼一样有效地减轻老年人的压力。

choices.text: Bring many of the same benefits as human social support.
choices.zh: 带来许多与人的社会支持相同的益处。
